name: Love Hurts
summary: Gan'rul sends you along Orgrimmar's main drag to find Magar. His longing for Krilge may reveal the object Gan'rul needs to lure an incubus into the world.

sections.title: Magar's Search
sections.body: East of the Cleft of Shadow, Magar longs for Krilge to return. He asks you to search for something precious. Bring that object to Gan'rul, who needs a token of love and devotion to summon an incubus.

faq.answer: Magar lives along Orgrimmar's main drag and longs for Krilge to return.
Krilge is Magar's mate, and Magar longs for Krilge's return.
An incubus is a male sayaad, profoundly evil and single-minded.
Gan'rul needs an object that represents great love and devotion to lure an incubus into the world.
Magar lives east of the Cleft of Shadow along Orgrimmar's main drag.
